newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Neuhaus IPO closed to institutions, price 1,750 Bfr.
newsitem.headline: Neuhaus IPO closed to institutions, price 1,750 Bfr.

text.p: The initial public offering of shares in Belgian praline maker Neuhaus NV has been closed to institutions and the price for the public offering set at 1,750 Belgian francs, lead managers Petercam said on Friday.
"The public offer will now start on Monday, which is earlier than we had planned," a Petercam spokesman told Reuters.

Petercam said earlier this week 450,000 shares would be sold at between 1,600 and 1,750 francs. Two thirds of the offering is targeted at institutions. The public offer of around 150,000 shares was originally due to start on February 27.
The shares will be listed on March 10.
